summary: The customer requests 120 cups for a staff event on 28 Oct, with about 70% having no sugar and a budget of VND 8,400,000. Delivery is requested to Building 3 by 14:30, together with a menu showing prices.
The customer requests about 40 cups per day for 5 days, from 20 Oct to 24 Oct, with a total budget of MYR 1,800. Confirmation is needed before 15 Oct so parents can be informed.

The prospect wants 15 stores in Qingdao, initially 3, with an initial site on Taidong Pedestrian Street of about 45 square metres and monthly rent of about RMB 45,000. It has a total budget of RMB 2.2 million and requests franchise terms, initial investment details and an opening timetable.
The customer wants a mix of milk tea and fruit tea for an office-opening ceremony next week, with headcount to be confirmed by Friday. It asks whether delivery to Nongsa is available.

The supplier offers 5,000 L of fresh milk per week at MYR 4.20 per litre, with 3.6% fat and protein above 3.2 g per 100 mL. It offers an 18% discount for an annual contract and delivery 3 times a week.

The customer requests delivery of 8 trays of 12 cups to its Hanoi office every Monday at 9 am, equivalent to 96 cups per delivery, with monthly invoicing. It asks for an allergen list for each drink and confirmation of the price per tray.

The customer needs only 5 cups for the management team on the initial day of its new production line next month. A later full-team celebration would need 50 cups at an unconfirmed date, and prices are requested for both orders.

The prospect offers a 6 m2 kiosk with rent of 50,000 baht per month plus a 10% revenue share. It asks about a Teaheart kiosk and reports about 600 daily drink sales across all stalls in the food court.

The prospect estimates that one drinks store in its university-area commercial street could sell 2,000 cups per day and says the school requires drinks to contain less than 35 grams of sugar. It aims to open before March 2027 and asks for franchise requirements and initial investment costs.
The prospect wants 30 stores over 3 years, with an initial flagship of 320 m2 in Cebu IT Park and an initial-store budget of PHP 1.2 million. It requests master franchise terms for the Philippines.

The customer wants two small Teaheart counters inside its plant for about 800 staff, with a budget of around USD 150,000 and a target opening of 1 Feb 2027. Each counter should serve at least 25 cups per hour at peak.

The customer reports about 2,000 daily cup sales across 4 canteen stalls and proposes free samples equal to about 5% of daily cups for one month. This implies about 100 samples per day, and the customer asks what the campaign would cost.
